film.title: Tucker and Dale vs. Evil
S: Lake catfish bites with comeback sauce
Dale pulls Allison out of the lake

Stir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon into comeback sauce. Soak the fish in the buttermilk while you mix the cornmeal, flour, paprika and salt. Toss the fish in the cornmeal and fry in hot oil in batches until crisp. Drain, salt and serve with the sauce and lemon.
500g skinless basa or catfish fillets, cut in chunks@Seafood
Gas station chilli dogs with cheese
Dale says hi holding a scythe

Brown the mince with half the onion, add the spices and tomatoes and simmer until thick. Grill the franks until blistered. Fill the rolls, spoon over the chilli and top with cheddar, the rest of the onion and mustard.
M: Wood chipper pulled pork rolls with slaw
Mike dives into the wood chipper

Rub the pork with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Put it in a lidded pot with the apple juice and cook at 150C until it falls apart. Shred with two forks and stir through the barbecue sauce and some of the juices. Toss the cabbage and apple with the mayonnaise and vinegar. Pile the pork and slaw into the rolls.

Toss the chicken with the oil, paprika, garlic and salt. Warm the honey with the chilli flakes and vinegar and set aside. Grill the chicken and corn over medium-high heat, turning, until charred and cooked through. Brush the chicken with the hot honey for the last few minutes, butter the corn and serve.
W: Chamomile honey cake with whipped cream
Dale throws the chamomile tea at Chad

Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 10 minutes, then squeeze them out. Beat the butter, sugar and honey until pale, then beat in the eggs. Fold in the flour and the tea, pour into a lined 20cm tin and bake at 170C until a skewer comes out clean. Cool, then serve in wedges with whipped cream and more honey.
K: Bury the cans in ice in the esky. Crack one each and pass them round the fire.
8 x 355ml cans Pabst Blue Ribbon beer@Bottle shop
film.T: Two nice guys. One very bad misunderstanding.
film.D: Two kind hillbillies fixing up their dream cabin get taken for killers by college kids who keep dying by accident.
film.P: Serve the honey chicken when Tucker saws into the beehive.

note.text: Oh hidy ho officer, we've had a doozy of a day.

dishes.n: Lake catfish bites with comeback sauce
dishes.make_ahead: Mix the sauce up to 3 days ahead; crumb and fry the fish to serve

ingredients.item: skinless basa or catfish fillets, cut in chunks

steps.text: Stir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon into comeback sauce.
Soak the fish in the buttermilk while you mix the cornmeal, flour, paprika and salt.
Toss the fish in the cornmeal and fry in hot oil in batches until crisp.
Drain, salt and serve with the sauce and lemon.

veg.n: Lake fried green tomatoes with comeback sauce (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Mix the sauce up to 3 days ahead; crumb and fry the tomatoes to serve

steps.text: Mix the comeback sauce.
Dip the tomato slices in buttermilk, then the cornmeal and flour.
Fry until golden on both sides and serve with the sauce.

dishes.n: Gas station chilli dogs with cheese
dishes.make_ahead: Make the chilli up to 3 days ahead and reheat; grill the franks to serve

steps.text: Brown the mince with half the onion, add the spices and tomatoes and simmer until thick.
Grill the franks until blistered.
Fill the rolls, spoon over the chilli and top with cheddar, the rest of the onion and mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Make the bean chilli up to 3 days ahead; grill the sausages to serve

steps.text: Simmer the beans, half the onion, chilli powder and tomatoes until thick, mashing a few beans.
Grill the vegetarian sausages.
Fill the rolls and top with chilli, cheddar, onion and mustard.

dishes.n: Wood chipper pulled pork rolls with slaw
dishes.make_ahead: Cook and pull the pork up to 2 days ahead; reheat in its juices and make the slaw on the day

steps.text: Rub the pork with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Put it in a lidded pot with the apple juice and cook at 150C until it falls apart.
Shred with two forks and stir through the barbecue sauce and some of the juices.
Toss the cabbage and apple with the mayonnaise and vinegar.
Pile the pork and slaw into the rolls.

veg.n: Wood chipper pulled jackfruit rolls with slaw (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Cook the jackfruit up to 2 days ahead and reheat; make the slaw on the day

ingredients.item: x 400g tins young green jackfruit, drained

steps.text: Fry the jackfruit in the oil with the paprika and sugar, pressing it apart.
Add the barbecue sauce and stock and simmer until sticky, then shred.
Make the slaw.
Fill the rolls.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate the chicken up to a day ahead; mix the hot honey up to a week ahead

steps.text: Toss the chicken with the oil, paprika, garlic and salt.
Warm the honey with the chilli flakes and vinegar and set aside.
Grill the chicken and corn over medium-high heat, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Brush the chicken with the hot honey for the last few minutes, butter the corn and serve.

veg.n: Beehive hot honey haloumi and corn (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Mix the hot honey up to a week ahead; grill to serve

steps.text: Warm the honey with the chilli and vinegar.
Grill the corn until charred.
Grill the haloumi briefly on both sides, brush with hot honey and serve with the buttered corn.

dishes.n: Chamomile honey cake with whipped cream
dishes.make_ahead: Bake the cake up to 2 days ahead and keep it covered; whip the cream to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 10 minutes, then squeeze them out.
Beat the butter, sugar and honey until pale, then beat in the eggs.
Fold in the flour and the tea, pour into a lined 20cm tin and bake at 170C until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool, then serve in wedges with whipped cream and more honey.
